thread:
alana_sales: Heads up — Aurora POC is failing during rerank. Client sends embeddings and gets a 400 dims error and sometimes a 413 when they send large candidate lists. Can we swarm? :eyes:
dev_kai: Please paste the exact error and a sanitized request payload.
alana_sales: From their log (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/rerank HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "query_embedding": [0.11, 0.05, ...],
  "candidates": [[...], [...]],
  "rerank_model": "rerank-pro"
}

Response: 400 Bad Request
{
  "error": "embedding dimension mismatch: expected 1536, got 256"
}
```
mei_ml: 256 wow — they're using a highly compact embed. Causes: old internal model, or they're hashing/compressing.
frank_se: Two issues: dims mismatch + 413 on big candidate batches (they tried 6k). For rerank-pro recommend chunking to <=200 or use streaming. Also ask them to gzip.
alana_sales: They say their library returns base64 strings for vectors in some paths and plain arrays in others; inconsistent.
dev_kai: That explains intermittent parse/413 issues (base64 inflates size). Ask them to normalize to JSON arrays of floats. Quick check snippet for them:```python
vec = client.get_embedding('sample')
print(type(vec), len(vec))
```
mei_ml: Short-term unblock options: 1) Server-side embed: send raw docs, we embed with our 1536 model before rerank. 2) Client migrate to our embed model. 3) Provide a temporary projection 256->1536 but warn about quality.
frank_se: For POC I'm fine enabling server-side embed and doc caching for repeated docs to reduce latency. We'll set max_candidates=200.
alana_sales: Can you post a curl for server-side embed so Aurora can test quickly?
dev_kai: cURL example:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"raw_documents":["doc1","doc2"], "query":"how to migrate", "rerank_model":"rerank-pro", "embed_on_server":true, "max_candidates":200}'
```
alana_sales: Aurora tried that and the dims error disappeared but latency increased ~140ms for 200 candidates. They're ok for the demo if we can offer a small POC credit.
mei_ml: Perf tips: prefilter with ANN (client-side embed + top-K 250) then rerank; use rerank-base for demo; enable KV caching for docs.
olivia_sec: Security note: if they send raw user data we need NDA + infosec questionnaire before ingesting PII. For Dedicated/private deployments we'll require SAML and KMS details. I'll send SOC2 + pen test summary.
frank_se: I'll enable embed_on_server and doc_cache for org-aurora for 72h and set max_candidates=200. Also will provide a short patch that normalizes base64 -> float arrays if they need it.
ops_bot: Feature toggle updated: embed_on_server=true, doc_cache=true, max_candidates=200 for org-aurora at 2027-11-02T08:30:00Z
alana_sales: Thanks team. Aurora will run the demo tonight and confirm. I'll open a finance thread for POC credit and start the NDA flow. :thumbsup:
